title: Từ vựng cơ bản B2
description: Trọn bộ từ vựng bậc B2 theo chuẩn CEFR, nối tiếp A1-B1 với từ học thuật, trừu tượng và dùng trong tranh luận, phân tích.

items.definition: đổ lỗi, quy trách nhiệm cho
items.pattern: Động từ; cấu trúc 'blame sb for sth' hoặc 'blame sth on sb'; trái nghĩa với praise.

examples.en: Don't blame me for a mistake I didn't make.
The manager blamed the delay on poor planning.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: Although three departments approved the design, the director tried to ___ the junior engineer for its failure.
The coach refused to ___ the goalkeeper when the entire defence had played badly.

items.definition: mù, khiếm thị; mù quáng, không nhận ra
items.pattern: Tính từ; 'blind to sth' = không nhận ra điều gì; thành ngữ 'turn a blind eye to' = làm ngơ.

examples.en: Her grandfather went blind in his seventies.
He was completely blind to his own faults.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: After the accident damaged his optic nerves, he became permanently ___.
Her loyalty to the company made her ___ to obvious signs of corruption.

items.definition: chuyển đổi, biến đổi; cải đạo
items.pattern: Động từ; 'convert sth into/to sth'; danh từ liên quan là conversion.

examples.en: They plan to convert the old barn into a holiday home.
She converted to Buddhism after travelling in Asia.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: The owners plan to ___ the disused warehouse into affordable apartments.
The software can ___ a scanned document into searchable text without retyping it.

items.definition: tin chắc, bị thuyết phục
items.pattern: Tính từ; thường đi với 'convinced that...' hoặc 'convinced of sth'; nghĩa mạnh hơn sure.

examples.en: I'm convinced that he is telling the truth.
She remained convinced of his innocence despite the evidence.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: Despite the politician's confident speech, few voters were ___ by his promises.
After seeing the laboratory results, the sceptical doctor was ___ that the treatment worked.

items.definition: bỏ rơi, ruồng bỏ; bỏ dở, từ bỏ
items.pattern: Động từ trang trọng; 'abandon a plan/ship/child'; đồng nghĩa desert, give up.

examples.en: The crew had to abandon the sinking ship.
They abandoned the search once it got dark.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: When the floodwaters rose, firefighters ordered residents to ___ their homes immediately.
The researchers had to ___ the experiment because the samples became contaminated.

items.definition: mối liên kết, sự gắn bó; trái phiếu
items.pattern: Danh từ; 'a close bond between...'; nghĩa tài chính: 'government bonds'.

examples.en: There is a strong bond between the two sisters.
She invested most of her savings in government bonds.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: Years of caring for her younger brother created a strong ___ between them.
The government issued a ten-year ___ to borrow money from investors.

items.definition: lõi, nhân; phần cốt lõi, trọng tâm
items.pattern: Danh từ; 'the core of the problem', 'core values'; nghĩa cụ thể: 'an apple core'.

examples.en: The core of the apple had gone rotten.
Honesty lies at the core of their business.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: At the ___ of the dispute was a disagreement about who owned the data.
Scientists believe Earth's outer ___ consists mainly of liquid iron and nickel.

items.definition: tuyệt đối, hoàn toàn
items.pattern: Tính từ; 'absolute silence/power/truth'; trạng từ absolutely dùng để nhấn mạnh.

examples.en: There was absolute silence in the examination hall.
The king once held absolute power over his people.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: The agreement gives the director ___ control, with no requirement to consult the board.
The witness spoke with ___ certainty, although no recording supported her account.

items.definition: thuộc về công ty, thuộc doanh nghiệp
items.pattern: Tính từ; 'corporate culture/image/strategy'; liên quan danh từ corporation.

examples.en: The company is trying hard to improve its corporate image.
Many corporate executives attended the conference.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: The company introduced new ___ rules to govern employee expenses and travel.
After the merger, the two firms struggled to combine their different ___ cultures.

items.definition: ngực, bầu vú; ức (thịt gia cầm)
items.pattern: Danh từ; 'chicken breast' = ức gà; cụm y học 'breast cancer'.

examples.en: She ordered a grilled chicken breast with salad.
Regular screening helps doctors detect breast cancer early.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: The doctor examined a small lump in the patient's left ___.
The restaurant served grilled chicken ___ with lemon and herbs.

items.definition: hội đồng, ủy ban
items.pattern: Danh từ; 'city/local council'; dễ nhầm với 'counsel' (lời khuyên, luật sư).

examples.en: The local council has approved plans for a new park.
She was elected to the city council last year.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: The city ___ voted to build a pedestrian bridge across the river.
A panel of elected representatives formed a ___ to advise the university president.

items.definition: có thể chấp nhận được, thỏa đáng
items.pattern: Tính từ; 'acceptable to sb'; trái nghĩa unacceptable; cụm 'socially acceptable'.

examples.en: Your behaviour at the meeting was simply not acceptable.
In the end we reached an acceptable compromise.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: A report with no sources or references is not ___ for a university assignment.
The inspector judged the water quality ___ after testing it for harmful bacteria.

items.definition: hơi thở
items.pattern: Danh từ (khác động từ breathe); 'take a deep breath'; 'out of breath' = hụt hơi.

examples.en: Take a deep breath and try to relax.
She was out of breath after running up the stairs.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: After running up five flights of stairs, she was completely out of ___.
He held his ___ underwater until he reached the other side of the pool.

items.definition: hạt, quận (đơn vị hành chính)
items.pattern: Danh từ; đơn vị hành chính ở Anh và Mỹ; dễ nhầm với 'country' (quốc gia).

examples.en: He grew up in a small village in the county of Kent.
The county has invested heavily in new schools.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: The small town lies within a rural ___ administered from the regional capital.
The school received its funding from the ___ authority rather than the national ministry.

items.definition: đi cùng, tháp tùng; đệm nhạc, đi kèm
items.pattern: Động từ trang trọng; 'accompany sb to/on'; 'accompanied by' = kèm theo.

examples.en: A teacher will accompany the students on the trip.
The thunder was accompanied by heavy rain.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: For safety reasons, an adult must ___ every child on the museum trip.
A pianist will ___ the singer during her performance at the ceremony.

items.definition: ngắn gọn, vắn tắt; ngắn ngủi
items.pattern: Tính từ; 'a brief meeting/visit'; cụm 'in brief' = tóm lại; trạng từ briefly.

examples.en: He gave a brief summary of the report.
We had a brief conversation before the meeting started.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: The manager gave a ___ explanation because the meeting was already running late.
Their visit was so ___ that they barely had time to unpack their bags.

items.definition: lòng can đảm, dũng khí
items.pattern: Danh từ không đếm được; 'have the courage to do sth'; tính từ courageous.

examples.en: It took great courage to admit his mistake in public.
She didn't have the courage to tell him the truth.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: It took enormous ___ to report the company's illegal activities despite threats.
The firefighter showed remarkable ___ by entering the burning building to rescue a child.

items.definition: rộng; bao quát, khái quát
items.pattern: Tính từ; 'broad shoulders/range'; 'in broad terms' = nói chung; trái nghĩa narrow.

examples.en: The river is quite broad at this point.
The course covers a broad range of topics.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: The scholarship programme covers a ___ range of subjects, from biology to philosophy.
The river was too ___ to cross without a boat or bridge.

items.definition: vụ va chạm, tai nạn; sự sụp đổ (thị trường); sự treo máy
items.pattern: Danh từ; 'a car/plane crash'; 'a stock market crash'; nghĩa máy tính là treo máy.

examples.en: Three people were injured in the car crash.
The 1929 stock market crash ruined many investors.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: The pilot survived the plane ___ but suffered several broken bones.
The sudden stock-market ___ wiped billions off investors' portfolios.

items.definition: chính xác, đúng đắn
items.pattern: Tính từ; 'an accurate description/measurement'; trái nghĩa inaccurate; trạng từ accurately.

examples.en: The weather forecast turned out to be surprisingly accurate.
We need accurate figures before making a decision.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: The engineer checked every measurement twice to ensure the calculations were ___.
The journalist corrected several errors before publishing an ___ account of events.

items.definition: phát sóng, truyền phát
items.pattern: Động từ bất quy tắc (broadcast-broadcast); 'broadcast live'; cũng dùng làm danh từ.

examples.en: The station will broadcast the match live tomorrow.
The interview was broadcast across the whole country.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: The ceremony will be ___ live on national television and online.
The local radio station ___ an emergency warning when the storm approached.

items.definition: sự tạo ra, sự sáng tạo; vật được tạo ra, tác phẩm
items.pattern: Danh từ; 'job creation' = tạo việc làm; liên quan động từ create.

examples.en: The creation of new jobs is the government's main priority.
The cake was a wonderful creation covered in chocolate.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: The ___ of the nature reserve protected hundreds of endangered animals.
The artist's latest ___ combines recycled metal with coloured glass.

items.definition: buộc tội, tố cáo, cáo buộc
items.pattern: Động từ; cấu trúc 'accuse sb of (doing) sth'; danh từ accusation.

examples.en: They accused him of stealing the money.
She was accused of lying to the police.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: Without evidence, it would be unfair to ___ your colleague of stealing the funds.
Prosecutors plan to ___ the official of deliberately hiding public records.

items.definition: ngân sách, kinh phí
items.pattern: Danh từ; 'on a tight budget', 'the annual budget'; cũng làm tính từ: 'a budget hotel'.

examples.en: We managed to stay within our budget this month.
The government announced cuts to the education budget.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: The school cannot buy new computers because its annual ___ has already been spent.
We prepared a detailed ___ showing how much the trip would cost.

items.definition: sinh vật, loài vật
items.pattern: Danh từ; 'living creatures'; nhấn mạnh một sinh vật sống, thường là động vật.

examples.en: Owls are fascinating creatures that hunt at night.
The deep ocean is home to many strange creatures.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: The diver photographed a strange sea ___ with transparent skin and eight arms.
Every living ___ in the forest depends on clean water and a healthy habitat.

items.definition: thừa nhận, công nhận; xác nhận đã nhận
items.pattern: Động từ trang trọng; 'acknowledge that...'; 'acknowledge receipt of' = xác nhận đã nhận.

examples.en: He refused to acknowledge that he was wrong.
Please acknowledge receipt of this email as soon as possible.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: The minister finally agreed to ___ that the policy had failed.
Please ___ receipt of this email so I know the documents arrived safely.
A notice gave the following instruction: "Please ___ receipt of this email so I know the documents arrived safely."

items.definition: viên đạn; dấu đầu dòng (bullet point)
items.pattern: Danh từ; 'a bullet wound'; trong văn bản 'bullet points' = các gạch đầu dòng.

examples.en: The bullet missed him by only a few centimetres.
List the main ideas as bullet points on the slide.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: Police found a ___ lodged in the wall after the shooting.
The presenter used a ___ point to list each recommendation on the slide.

items.definition: đạt được, thu được, có được (kỹ năng, tài sản)
items.pattern: Động từ trang trọng; 'acquire a skill/company/habit'; danh từ acquisition.

examples.en: She acquired a good knowledge of Spanish while living abroad.
The firm acquired three smaller companies last year.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: New employees need time to ___ the skills required for this technical role.
The museum hopes to ___ a rare painting from a private collector.

items.definition: bó, chùm, nải; một nhóm (thân mật)
items.pattern: Danh từ; 'a bunch of flowers/grapes/keys'; thân mật: 'a bunch of people'.

examples.en: He gave her a bunch of flowers for her birthday.
A bunch of us are going to the beach this weekend.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: She placed a ___ of fresh flowers in a vase beside the window.
The children gathered a ___ of grapes from the garden vine.

items.definition: phi hành đoàn, thủy thủ đoàn; đội, êkíp
items.pattern: Danh từ tập hợp; 'the ship's crew', 'a film crew'.

examples.en: The entire crew survived the shipwreck.
A film crew was setting up cameras in the street.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: The flight ___ instructed passengers to fasten their seat belts before landing.
A rescue ___ searched the flooded neighbourhood in two small boats.

items.definition: thực tế, thực sự (đối lập với tưởng tượng/dự kiến)
items.pattern: Tính từ; 'the actual cost/figures'; lưu ý KHÔNG có nghĩa 'hiện tại'; trạng từ actually.

examples.en: The actual cost was much higher than we had expected.
Nobody knows the actual number of people affected.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: The ___ cost was twice the amount originally estimated by the contractor.
The film's dramatic ending differs substantially from the ___ historical events.

items.definition: khủng hoảng, cơn khủng hoảng
items.pattern: Danh từ; số nhiều bất quy tắc là crises; 'an economic/financial crisis'.

examples.en: The country is facing a serious economic crisis.
The government has handled several crises this year.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: The country faced a financial ___ when several major banks collapsed.
A severe water ___ forced the city to introduce emergency restrictions.

items.definition: thích nghi, thích ứng; chuyển thể, sửa cho phù hợp
items.pattern: Động từ; 'adapt to sth' = thích nghi; 'adapt sth for/into' = chuyển thể; danh từ adaptation.

examples.en: It took her a while to adapt to life in a new city.
The novel was adapted into a successful film.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: Desert plants have evolved to ___ to long periods without rain.
The director had to ___ the novel for television without losing its main storyline.

items.definition: bụi cây, cây bụi; vùng hoang dã (Úc, Phi)
items.pattern: Danh từ; 'a rose bush'; thành ngữ 'beat about the bush' = nói vòng vo.

examples.en: A rabbit was hiding behind the bush.
Stop beating about the bush and tell me the truth.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: The missing ball was hidden beneath a thick ___ in the garden.
A startled rabbit emerged from the ___ beside the narrow path.

items.definition: tiêu chí, tiêu chuẩn
items.pattern: Danh từ; số nhiều bất quy tắc là criteria; 'meet the criteria'.

examples.en: Price is not the only criterion we take into account.
Applicants must meet all the criteria for the job.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: Previous professional experience is an important ___ for selecting applicants.
The main ___ for admission is a score above eighty on the entrance test.
Previous professional experience is a significant ___ for selecting applicants.

items.definition: thêm vào, bổ sung
items.pattern: Tính từ; 'additional information/cost'; đồng nghĩa extra; trạng từ additionally.

examples.en: There is an additional charge for breakfast at the hotel.
We need some additional information before we proceed.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: The hotel charged an ___ fee for checking out three hours late.
We need ___ evidence before we can draw a reliable conclusion.

items.definition: nhà phê bình; người chỉ trích
items.pattern: Danh từ chỉ người; 'a film/music critic'; phân biệt với critical (tính từ) và critique.

examples.en: The film received glowing reviews from the critics.
She is one of the government's harshest critics.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: The theatre ___ praised the actors but described the plot as predictable.
A leading ___ of the policy argued that it unfairly penalised poorer families.

items.definition: dây cáp; truyền hình cáp
items.pattern: Danh từ; 'an electric cable'; 'cable TV'; cũng chỉ dây thừng hoặc cáp thép.

examples.en: The electrician replaced the old cable behind the wall.
We watch most of our films on cable TV.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: An electrician replaced the damaged power ___ before reconnecting the machine.
The bridge is supported by steel ___ stretched between two enormous towers.

items.definition: hay chỉ trích; quan trọng sống còn, then chốt; nguy kịch
items.pattern: Tính từ; 'critical of sth' = chỉ trích; 'a critical moment' = then chốt; 'critical condition' = nguy kịch.

examples.en: She was very critical of the way the project was managed.
The next few days will be critical for the peace talks.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: The patient's condition remained ___ after emergency surgery.
Reliable electricity is ___ to the safe operation of the hospital's equipment.

items.definition: sự quản lý, sự điều hành; chính quyền, ban quản trị
items.pattern: Danh từ; 'business administration'; nghĩa Mỹ: 'the administration' = chính quyền.

examples.en: The administration of the hospital clearly needs to improve.
The new administration promised lower taxes.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: The new university ___ promised to improve student support services.
Poor ___ of the project caused delays and unnecessary expenditure.

items.definition: tính toán, tính; ước tính, dự tính
items.pattern: Động từ; 'calculate the cost/risk'; danh từ calculation; 'a calculated risk' = rủi ro có tính toán.

examples.en: Let me calculate how much the whole trip will cost.
Scientists calculated the distance to the nearest star.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: The accountant had to ___ the total cost by adding the price of each item.
Scientists can ___ the distance to a star using its apparent movement in the sky.

items.definition: sự chỉ trích, lời phê bình
items.pattern: Danh từ thường không đếm được; 'constructive criticism'; 'face/attract criticism'.

examples.en: The new plan has attracted a great deal of criticism.
He finds it hard to accept any criticism of his work.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: The minister faced sharp ___ over the decision to close rural hospitals.
Her review included constructive ___ about the argument's weak conclusion.

items.definition: nhận nuôi; áp dụng, thông qua (chính sách, phương pháp)
items.pattern: Động từ; 'adopt a child' = nhận con nuôi; 'adopt a policy/approach'; danh từ adoption.

examples.en: They decided to adopt a child from overseas.
The company adopted a new marketing strategy last year.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: After years in foster care, the little girl was finally ___ by a family.
The school decided to ___ a new approach to teaching foreign languages.

items.definition: hủy bỏ, bãi bỏ
items.pattern: Động từ; 'cancel a meeting/flight/order'; danh từ cancellation (gấp đôi chữ l ở Anh).

examples.en: We had to cancel the trip because of the storm.
Her flight was cancelled due to bad weather.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: The airline had to ___ all flights because of the volcanic ash cloud.
If you no longer need the service, you can ___ your subscription online.

items.definition: chỉ trích, phê bình
items.pattern: Động từ; 'criticize sb for (doing) sth'; trái nghĩa praise; cách viết Anh là criticise.

examples.en: The press criticized the government for its slow response.
It's easy to criticize, but much harder to offer solutions.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: It is easy to ___ the plan, but harder to suggest a workable alternative.
Several reviewers ___ the film for its inaccurate portrayal of history.

items.definition: sự tiến bộ, tiến triển; khoản tiền ứng trước
items.pattern: Danh từ; 'advances in technology'; cụm 'in advance' = trước, sẵn.

examples.en: Recent advances in medicine have saved countless lives.
Please book your tickets well in advance.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: The discovery marked a major ___ in the treatment of inherited diseases.
The publisher paid the author an ___ before the book was completed.

items.definition: bệnh ung thư
items.pattern: Danh từ; 'lung/breast cancer'; 'develop/be diagnosed with cancer'.

examples.en: Early detection of cancer can save lives.
He was diagnosed with lung cancer last spring.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: The hospital offers screening to detect breast ___ at an early stage.
Some forms of ___ develop when cells divide uncontrollably and form tumours.

items.definition: vụ mùa, cây trồng; sản lượng thu hoạch
items.pattern: Danh từ; 'grow/harvest crops'; nghĩa bóng 'a crop of' = một loạt.

examples.en: Farmers are worried that the drought will ruin their crops.
This year's wheat crop was the best in a decade.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: The farmers lost most of their wheat ___ after months without rain.
A new disease threatened the region's main food ___, which feeds thousands of families.

items.definition: việc, vấn đề, sự vụ; chuyện tình ái, ngoại tình
items.pattern: Danh từ; 'current affairs' = thời sự; 'have an affair' = ngoại tình; số nhiều 'affairs' = công việc.

examples.en: The wedding was a grand affair with hundreds of guests.
He was having an affair with a colleague.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: The investigation focused on the minister's handling of the entire ___.
The newspaper reported that the married politician had been involved in a secret ___.

items.definition: có khả năng, có năng lực
items.pattern: Tính từ; 'capable of (doing) sth'; trái nghĩa incapable; danh từ capability.

examples.en: She is perfectly capable of looking after herself.
The new engine is capable of remarkable speeds.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: Although she has little experience, she is fully ___ of leading the team.
The new computer is ___ of processing thousands of images every second.

items.definition: quan trọng mang tính quyết định, then chốt
items.pattern: Tính từ; 'crucial to/for sth'; 'a crucial moment/decision'; nghĩa mạnh hơn important.

examples.en: Getting enough sleep is crucial for good health.
This is a crucial moment in the country's history.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: Reliable evidence is ___ if the court is to reach a fair decision.
Early medical treatment can play a ___ role in preventing permanent injury.

items.definition: sau đó, về sau
items.pattern: Trạng từ; đứng đầu hoặc cuối câu; cách viết Mỹ là afterward; đồng nghĩa later.

examples.en: We had dinner and went for a long walk afterwards.
Afterwards, she realized she had made a mistake.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: We visited the ancient temple and went to a nearby café ___.
The lecture ended at six, and ___ the students stayed to ask questions.

items.definition: sức chứa, dung lượng; khả năng, năng lực
items.pattern: Danh từ; 'seating capacity'; 'capacity to do sth'; 'at full capacity' = hết công suất.

examples.en: The stadium has a capacity of sixty thousand people.
Humans have an enormous capacity for learning.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: The theatre has a seating ___ of eight hundred people.
The hospital is operating at full ___, so no more patients can be admitted.

items.definition: cơ quan, hãng, đại lý
items.pattern: Danh từ; 'a travel/advertising agency'; 'a government/aid agency'.

examples.en: She works for an advertising agency in London.
The aid agency sent supplies to the flooded region.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: The advertising ___ designed a national campaign for the new product.
An international aid ___ delivered emergency supplies to the disaster zone.

items.definition: bắt giữ, chiếm được; ghi lại, nắm bắt (khoảnh khắc, cảm xúc)
items.pattern: Động từ; 'capture a prisoner/town'; 'capture the moment/mood'; 'capture market share'.

examples.en: Soldiers captured the enemy town after a long battle.
The photograph perfectly captures the joy of the moment.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: The photographer waited for hours to ___ the exact moment the eagle took flight.
Security forces managed to ___ the escaped prisoner near the border.

items.definition: chữa khỏi, chữa trị
items.pattern: Động từ; 'cure sb of sth', 'cure a disease'; cũng là danh từ 'a cure for'.

examples.en: Doctors still cannot cure the common cold.
The treatment cured her of the infection within days.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: Doctors have not yet found a way to ___ this inherited condition completely.
A short course of antibiotics may ___ the bacterial infection if taken correctly.

items.definition: chương trình nghị sự; kế hoạch, ý đồ (ngầm)
items.pattern: Danh từ; 'top of the agenda'; 'a hidden agenda' = ý đồ giấu kín.

examples.en: The first item on the agenda is the budget.
Many people suspected that he had a hidden agenda.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: The first item on the meeting's ___ is the proposed budget for next year.
The journalist suspected that the report promoted a hidden political ___.

items.definition: dàn diễn viên; khuôn đúc; bó bột
items.pattern: Danh từ tập hợp; 'the cast of a play/film'; cũng là động từ cast (bất quy tắc).

examples.en: The entire cast gathered on stage for the final bow.
Her broken arm was in a cast for six weeks.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: The film's ___ includes several award-winning actors from different countries.
The doctor placed the child's broken arm in a plaster ___.

items.definition: hung hăng, hiếu chiến; mạnh bạo, quyết liệt
items.pattern: Tính từ; 'aggressive behaviour'; nghĩa tích cực: 'an aggressive marketing campaign'; trạng từ aggressively.

examples.en: The dog became aggressive when strangers approached.
The company launched an aggressive advertising campaign.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: The dog became ___ when a stranger approached its puppies.
The company adopted an ___ marketing strategy to take customers from its competitors.

items.definition: đường cong, chỗ uốn cong
items.pattern: Danh từ; 'a sharp curve in the road'; 'a learning curve' = quá trình học hỏi.

examples.en: There is a dangerous curve just past the bridge.
Starting a new job involves a steep learning curve.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: The road bends around a sharp ___ before climbing the mountain.
The graph shows a smooth upward ___ as temperatures increase.

items.definition: sự viện trợ, sự trợ giúp; dụng cụ hỗ trợ
items.pattern: Danh từ (thường không đếm); 'foreign/humanitarian aid'; 'a hearing aid'; cụm 'in aid of'.

examples.en: The country relies heavily on foreign aid.
She wears a hearing aid in her left ear.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: International ___ helped provide food and clean water after the earthquake.
A hearing ___ allows her grandfather to follow conversations more easily.

items.definition: tế bào; phòng giam; ô (bảng tính); pin
items.pattern: Danh từ; 'blood cells' (sinh học); 'a prison cell'; 'a spreadsheet cell'.

examples.en: The human body contains billions of tiny cells.
The prisoner spent years alone in a cramped cell.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: Under the microscope, the scientist could see the nucleus inside each ___.
The prisoner was locked in a small ___ until his court appearance.

items.definition: cong, uốn cong
items.pattern: Tính từ; 'a curved line/blade'; trái nghĩa straight.

examples.en: The path follows a gently curved line through the garden.
The old knife had a slightly curved blade.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: The architect designed a ___ roof that looked like the wing of a bird.
The path was ___ rather than straight, following the edge of the lake.

items.definition: máy bay, phi cơ
items.pattern: Danh từ; số ít và số nhiều giống nhau (one aircraft, two aircraft); trang trọng hơn plane.

examples.en: The aircraft landed safely despite the storm.
Several military aircraft flew low over the city.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: The airport closed one runway after an ___ made an emergency landing.
Engineers inspected the ___ before passengers were allowed to board.

items.definition: cuộc tranh luận, cuộc thảo luận
items.pattern: Danh từ; 'a heated debate'; 'under/open to debate' = đang còn bàn cãi; cũng là động từ.

examples.en: There was a lively debate about climate change.
The question of funding is still open to debate.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: The candidates held a televised ___ about taxation and healthcare.
A lively ___ began over whether university education should be free.

items.definition: thay đổi, sửa đổi (thường là chỉnh sửa nhỏ)
items.pattern: Động từ; 'alter a plan/dress'; sắc thái thay đổi một phần; danh từ alteration; phân biệt với alternate.

examples.en: We may need to alter our plans slightly.
The tailor altered the jacket to fit him better.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: The tailor agreed to ___ the jacket so that it fitted her shoulders.
The researchers had to ___ the experimental procedure after finding a safety risk.

items.definition: nợ, khoản nợ
items.pattern: Danh từ; chữ 'b' câm; 'be in debt' = mắc nợ; 'pay off a debt'; 'the national debt'.

examples.en: He worked hard for years to pay off his debt.
Many students are in debt by the time they graduate.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: After losing his job, he struggled to repay his credit-card ___.
The country borrowed heavily and accumulated an enormous national ___.

items.definition: đặc điểm, đặc tính, nét đặc trưng
items.pattern: Danh từ chỉ nét riêng của người/vật, thường đi với 'of' (a characteristic of); đừng nhầm với 'character' (tính cách tổng thể).

examples.en: Patience is a characteristic I admire in good teachers.
Each region has characteristics that set its cooking apart.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: A distinctive ___ of this bird is the bright red stripe on its head.
One important ___ of a reliable scientist is willingness to question assumptions.

items.definition: tử tế, đàng hoàng; kha khá, tạm ổn (chất lượng/số lượng đủ tốt)
items.pattern: Hai nét nghĩa: 'a decent person' (tử tế) và 'a decent salary/meal' (đủ tốt); sắc thái tích cực vừa phải, không phải xuất sắc.

examples.en: He earns a decent salary, enough to support his family comfortably.
It was decent of her to apologize in front of everyone.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: Despite the low price, the hostel provided a ___ room with clean bedding.
Her first salary was ___ enough to cover her rent and daily expenses.

items.definition: sự tức giận, cơn giận
items.pattern: Danh từ không đếm được; hay gặp 'in anger' (trong cơn giận), 'control/express your anger'; cùng dạng với động từ 'anger' (làm ai tức giận).

examples.en: She struggled to hide her anger when the meeting was cancelled again.
His words were spoken in anger and he later regretted them.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: News of the unfair dismissal provoked widespread ___ among factory workers.
He struggled to control his ___ when he discovered that his friend had lied.

items.definition: tuyên bố, công bố; khai báo (hải quan/thu nhập)
items.pattern: Trang trọng: 'declare war/independence', 'declare that + mệnh đề'; ở sân bay 'declare goods' là khai báo hàng hóa.

examples.en: The government will declare a state of emergency if the floods continue.
You must declare any goods you bought abroad at customs.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: The government plans to ___ a national emergency after the severe floods.
At the airport, travellers must ___ goods that exceed the duty-free allowance.

items.definition: góc (hình học); góc độ, khía cạnh (cách nhìn nhận)
items.pattern: 'at an angle' là nghiêng; 'from a different angle' là nhìn từ một góc khác; đo bằng độ (degrees).

examples.en: The photographer shot the building from a low angle to make it look taller.
Try looking at the problem from a different angle.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: The carpenter checked that the two wooden beams met at a right ___.
The reporter examined the housing problem from an economic ___ rather than a political one.

items.definition: chính yếu, chủ yếu, quan trọng nhất
items.pattern: Tính từ đứng trước danh từ: 'the chief reason/concern'; đồng nghĩa 'main, principal'; cũng xuất hiện trong chức danh như 'chief executive'.

examples.en: The chief advantage of this method is that it saves everyone time.
Safety remains the chief concern for everyone on the team.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: The ___ reason for the delay was the shortage of qualified engineers.
The company's ___ concern was protecting its customers' personal data.

items.definition: suy giảm, giảm sút; từ chối (một cách lịch sự)
items.pattern: Hai nghĩa: 'sales declined' (giảm) và 'decline an invitation/offer' (từ chối lịch sự); trang trọng hơn 'refuse'; danh từ cùng dạng 'a decline in...'.

examples.en: Sales began to decline sharply after the price increase.
She politely declined the offer to lead the project.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: The number of students choosing physics began to ___ after fees increased.
She politely ___ the invitation because she had another appointment.

items.definition: ngày kỷ niệm (hằng năm)
items.pattern: Hay gặp 'wedding anniversary', 'the 10th anniversary of'; luôn gắn với một sự kiện xảy ra đúng ngày này năm trước.

examples.en: They celebrated their tenth wedding anniversary with a trip to Italy.
The city held events to mark the anniversary of its founding.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: They returned to the restaurant where they first met to celebrate their wedding ___.
The museum marked the hundredth ___ of the scientist's birth with a special exhibition.

items.definition: hoàn cảnh, tình huống, điều kiện
items.pattern: Thường dùng số nhiều 'circumstances'; cụm cố định 'under the circumstances' (trong hoàn cảnh đó) và 'under no circumstances' (tuyệt đối không).

examples.en: In this particular circumstance, staying calm was the wisest choice.
Under no circumstances should you share your password with anyone.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: Under normal ___, the library closes at eight in the evening.
An unexpected family ___ forced him to postpone the journey.

items.definition: đồ trang trí; sự trang trí; (ít gặp) huân chương
items.pattern: Đếm được khi chỉ vật trang trí (Christmas decorations); không đếm khi chỉ hành động/phong cách trang trí, như 'interior decoration'.

examples.en: They hung a paper decoration above the doorway for the party.
The hall was filled with colourful decorations for the festival.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: The children made colourful paper ___ for the school celebration.
A simple flower arrangement was the only ___ on the dining table.

items.definition: hằng năm, thường niên; tính theo năm
items.pattern: Hay gặp 'annual report/meeting/income'; trạng từ là 'annually'; trang trọng hơn 'yearly' trong văn phong công sở.

examples.en: The company publishes an annual report every spring.
Her annual salary rose by five percent this year.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: The organisation publishes an ___ report summarising its work every twelve months.
Employees are entitled to twenty-five days of ___ leave each year.

items.definition: trích dẫn, dẫn ra (làm ví dụ/bằng chứng); viện dẫn (lý do)
items.pattern: Trang trọng, học thuật: 'cite a source/example/reason'; danh từ liên quan là 'citation'; dễ nhầm chính tả với 'site/sight'.

examples.en: Writers must cite every source they use in their essays.
He cited family reasons when he resigned from the board.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: The lecturer reminded students to ___ the original source whenever they quoted another author.
The lawyer could ___ several previous cases in support of her argument.

items.definition: giảm, làm giảm
items.pattern: Vừa nội động vừa ngoại động; đi với 'decrease by/to'; trái nghĩa 'increase'; danh từ cùng dạng nhưng khác trọng âm (n: DEcrease, v: deCREASE).

examples.en: Exercise can help decrease the risk of heart disease.
The number of visitors decreased sharply during the storm.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: The number of road accidents has begun to ___ since new speed limits were introduced.
The factory will ___ its water consumption by replacing old equipment.

items.definition: sâu sắc, hết sức (mức độ mạnh, nhất là về cảm xúc)
items.pattern: Nhấn mạnh cảm xúc: 'deeply moved/concerned/grateful'; khác 'deep' chỉ độ sâu vật lý; thường đứng trước tính từ hoặc động từ chỉ cảm xúc.

examples.en: She was deeply moved by the letter her students wrote.
Many people feel deeply about this issue.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: She was ___ moved by the letters from families whose homes had been destroyed.
The public was ___ concerned about the safety of the drinking water.

items.definition: lời biện hộ, cái cớ (để thoái thác)
items.pattern: 'make an excuse', 'a good/poor excuse for', 'there's no excuse for...'; cùng viết với động từ 'excuse' nhưng phát âm đuôi /-z/.

examples.en: He gave a weak excuse for arriving so late.
There is no excuse for treating customers rudely.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: Being tired is no ___ for speaking rudely to your colleagues.
He invented an ___ about a delayed train to explain why he missed the meeting.

items.definition: sôi nổi, sinh động, đầy sức sống
items.pattern: Tả người/không khí/cuộc tranh luận; đồng nghĩa 'energetic, animated'; đuôi -ly nhưng là tính từ, không phải trạng từ.

examples.en: The market was a lively place full of music and shouting vendors.
They had a lively discussion about the new policy.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: The discussion became especially ___ when students disagreed about the final question.
The town square was ___ with musicians and street performers throughout the festival.

items.definition: đánh bại, chiến thắng (đối thủ); làm thất bại (kế hoạch)
items.pattern: 'defeat an opponent/team/army'; thể bị động 'be defeated'; danh từ cùng dạng 'suffer a defeat'.

examples.en: Our team hopes to defeat the champions in tonight's match.
Their proposal was defeated by a narrow margin in parliament.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: The defending champions managed to ___ their strongest rivals in the final.
Unexpected technical problems threatened to ___ the team's plans for the launch.

items.definition: nhà quản lý cấp cao, giám đốc điều hành; cơ quan hành pháp
items.pattern: 'a senior executive', 'chief executive'; cũng làm tính từ 'executive decision/power'; chỉ người có quyền ra quyết định.

examples.en: She became a senior executive at the bank before turning forty.
The executives met to discuss the company's future.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: The company's chief ___ announced major changes to its international operations.
A senior ___ was responsible for negotiating the merger with its competitor.

items.definition: tải trọng, khối lượng chuyên chở; khối lượng công việc; (loads of = rất nhiều, thân mật)
items.pattern: 'a heavy load', 'a load of'; 'loads of' trong văn nói là rất nhiều; cùng dạng với động từ 'load' (chất, nạp).

examples.en: The truck carried a heavy load of bricks up the hill.
They shared the load so that nobody felt overwhelmed by the work.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: The bridge could not safely support the ___ of several heavy lorries at once.
The teacher reduced her students' homework ___ during examination week.

items.definition: sự phòng thủ, sự bảo vệ; sự bào chữa; hàng phòng ngự (thể thao)
items.pattern: Viết 'defence' (Anh), 'defense' (Mỹ); 'in defence of' là để bảo vệ; 'self-defence'; trong bóng đá chỉ hàng thủ.

examples.en: The soldiers prepared a strong defence against the attack.
She spoke in defence of her colleague's decision.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: The army built a strong ___ against an attack from the north.
The accused person's lawyer presented evidence in her ___.

items.definition: sự tồn tại, sự hiện hữu; (nghĩa bóng) cuộc sống khổ sở
items.pattern: 'come into existence' là ra đời; 'in existence' là đang tồn tại; bắt nguồn từ động từ 'exist'.

examples.en: Scientists still debate the existence of life on other planets.
The law has been in existence for over a century.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: Researchers found no reliable evidence for the ___ of life on the distant planet.
The factory's closure threatened the very ___ of the small community.

items.definition: khoản vay, tiền cho vay; sự cho mượn
items.pattern: 'take out / repay a loan', 'a bank loan'; 'on loan' là đang được cho mượn (sách, cầu thủ); động từ 'loan' ít gặp hơn 'lend'.

examples.en: They took out a loan to buy their first home.
The painting is on loan from a private collector.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: The bank approved a ___ to help the family purchase its first home.
The museum agreed to a temporary ___ of the painting for an overseas exhibition.

items.definition: bảo vệ, phòng thủ; bào chữa, biện hộ (cho)
items.pattern: 'defend against/from', 'defend your decision/yourself'; trong tòa án 'defend a client'; danh từ liên quan 'defence/defender'.

examples.en: Soldiers were sent to defend the city against invaders.
She defended her research when critics questioned it.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: The lawyer was appointed to ___ a young man accused of theft.
The soldiers were ordered to ___ the bridge against enemy forces.

items.definition: sự mong đợi, kỳ vọng
items.pattern: Thường số nhiều 'high/low expectations'; 'meet/exceed/fall short of expectations'; 'in the expectation that...'.

examples.en: The film lived up to every expectation the fans had.
Parents sometimes place high expectations on their children.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: The film failed to meet the audience's high ___ after months of publicity.
Parents should avoid placing unrealistic ___ on children who are still learning.

items.definition: rỗng, trống bên trong; (nghĩa bóng) trống rỗng, giả tạo
items.pattern: Nghĩa đen 'a hollow tree'; nghĩa bóng 'a hollow victory/promise' là vô nghĩa; cũng làm danh từ và động từ.

examples.en: The children hid their notes inside a hollow log.
His apology felt hollow because he kept making the same mistake.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: The tree looked solid from outside, but its trunk was completely ___.
His apology sounded ___ because he continued to repeat the same behaviour.

items.definition: hợp lý, logic, theo lẽ thường; thuộc về logic
items.pattern: 'a logical conclusion/explanation/step'; trái nghĩa 'illogical'; trạng từ 'logically'; tả lập luận chặt chẽ.

examples.en: Selling the old car was the logical thing to do.
Her argument followed a clear and logical order.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: The conclusion was ___ because it followed directly from the evidence.
It seemed ___ to repair the leaking roof before painting the damaged ceiling.

items.definition: trì hoãn, làm chậm trễ; chần chừ
items.pattern: Theo sau bởi V-ing: 'delay doing sth'; thể bị động 'be delayed'; danh từ cùng dạng 'a delay in/of'; khác 'postpone' (dời lịch có chủ ý).

examples.en: Heavy snow could delay the morning flights.
Don't delay booking your tickets if you want good seats.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: Heavy snow may ___ the morning trains by several hours.
The committee decided to ___ its decision until the missing evidence arrived.

items.definition: chi phí, khoản chi; (expenses) công tác phí
items.pattern: 'at the expense of' là phải trả giá bằng; 'travel expenses'; 'spare no expense'; không đếm được khi nói chung, đếm được khi là khoản cụ thể.

examples.en: The repair turned out to be a major expense for the family.
He finished the project on time, but at the expense of his health.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: The cost of replacing the equipment was an unexpected ___ for the school.
Employees can claim travel ___ if they provide receipts.

items.definition: thiêng liêng, thánh thiện
items.pattern: 'a holy place/book/day', gắn với tôn giáo; viết hoa trong danh xưng (the Holy Bible); đừng nhầm với 'wholly' (hoàn toàn).

examples.en: Pilgrims travel for weeks to reach the holy city.
The temple is considered a holy site by millions of people.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2

The ancient temple was considered a ___ place by generations of worshippers.

items.definition: dài hạn, lâu dài
items.pattern: Có gạch nối khi làm tính từ trước danh từ (a long-term plan); trái nghĩa 'short-term'; 'in the long term' (không gạch nối) nghĩa là về lâu dài.

examples.en: The company is making a long-term investment in clean energy.
Smoking causes serious long-term damage to the lungs.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: The scientists warned that pollution could have ___ effects on children's health.
The charity needs a ___ funding plan rather than occasional donations.

items.definition: cố ý, có chủ tâm; thong thả, thận trọng (chậm rãi)
items.pattern: Tính từ đọc /dɪˈlɪbərət/, khác động từ /dɪˈlɪbəreɪt/ (cân nhắc); 'a deliberate attempt/lie'; trái nghĩa 'accidental'.

examples.en: The damage was clearly a deliberate act, not an accident.
She spoke in a slow, deliberate voice so everyone understood.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: Investigators concluded that the fire was a ___ act rather than an accident.
The speaker used a slow, ___ pace to make every instruction clear.

items.definition: sự thăm dò, sự khám phá (vùng đất hoặc chủ đề)
items.pattern: 'space/oil exploration'; 'an exploration of' + chủ đề; bắt nguồn từ động từ 'explore'.

examples.en: Space exploration has revealed much about distant planets.
The book is a thoughtful exploration of childhood memories.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: Robotic vehicles have made the ___ of distant planets possible without risking human lives.
The essay offers a detailed ___ of how language shapes social identity.

items.definition: danh dự, vinh dự; sự kính trọng
items.pattern: Viết 'honour' (Anh), 'honor' (Mỹ); 'in honour of' là để vinh danh; 'it's an honour to...'; tính từ 'honourable'.

examples.en: It was a great honour to meet the author in person.
They held a dinner in honour of the retiring teacher.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: She considered it a great ___ to receive an award from the university.
The captain acted with ___ by admitting his mistake and protecting the team.

items.definition: lỏng, lỏng lẻo; rộng (quần áo); tự do, không bị nhốt
items.pattern: Đọc /luːs/, khác 'lose' /luːz/ (động từ mất); 'come loose' là bị tuột; 'loose clothing'; 'set an animal loose'.

examples.en: One of the screws had come loose and the shelf fell.
She prefers loose, comfortable clothes for travelling.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: The shelf fell because one of its screws had worked ___.
The shirt was too ___ around the waist, so she took it to a tailor.

items.definition: một cách cố ý, có chủ tâm; một cách thong thả
items.pattern: Nhấn mạnh ý định: 'do sth deliberately'; đồng nghĩa 'on purpose, intentionally'; trái nghĩa 'accidentally, by mistake'.

examples.en: He deliberately left out the bad news to avoid worrying them.
She walked slowly and deliberately toward the stage.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: The driver ___ ignored the red light despite seeing pedestrians at the crossing.
He spoke slowly and ___ so that everyone understood the instructions.

items.definition: phơi bày, để lộ (cho tiếp xúc); vạch trần, phanh phui
items.pattern: 'expose sb/sth to' là cho tiếp xúc với; 'expose a scandal/lie' là vạch trần; danh từ 'exposure'; hay dùng bị động 'be exposed to'.

examples.en: The report will expose the truth behind the scandal.
Children should not be exposed to such violent images.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: Investigative journalists worked to ___ the corruption hidden in public contracts.
Without protective clothing, workers might ___ their skin to harmful chemicals.

items.definition: lãnh chúa, nhà quý tộc (tước vị Anh); Chúa (tôn giáo, viết hoa)
items.pattern: 'Lord' là tước hiệu quý tộc Anh (Lord Byron); 'the Lord' là Chúa; 'lord it over sb' là ra oai với ai; mang màu sắc trang trọng, cổ.

examples.en: The castle once belonged to a powerful lord who ruled the valley.
In the past, a lord could demand taxes from the peasants.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: The medieval ___ controlled a large estate and demanded rent from its farmers.
The British ___ took his seat in the upper chamber of Parliament.

items.definition: làm vui thích, làm hài lòng; (delight in) thích thú làm gì
items.pattern: 'delight sb' là làm ai vui sướng; 'delight in doing sth' là khoái làm gì; danh từ cùng dạng 'take delight in'; văn vẻ, trang trọng.

examples.en: The magician's tricks never fail to delight young audiences.
She delights in telling stories about her travels.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: The magician's tricks never fail to ___ the children in the audience.
The unexpected invitation will ___ her because she has always admired the writer.

items.definition: kéo dài, gia hạn; mở rộng; đưa/chìa ra (tay); ngỏ (lời mời, lời cảm ơn)
items.pattern: 'extend a deadline/visa' (gia hạn), 'extend a hand', 'extend an invitation'; danh từ 'extension'; trái nghĩa 'shorten'.

examples.en: They decided to extend the deadline by one week.
The garden extends all the way down to the river.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: The university agreed to ___ the application deadline by two weeks.
The city plans to ___ the cycle path all the way to the railway station.

items.definition: rất vui mừng, hân hoan
items.pattern: 'delighted to do sth / that / with / by'; mạnh hơn 'pleased'; thường dùng khi nhận tin vui hoặc nhận lời mời ('I'd be delighted to help').

examples.en: She was delighted to hear that she had passed the exam.
We are delighted with the results of the survey.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: Her parents were ___ when she received a scholarship to study abroad.
We were absolutely ___ with the hotel staff's kindness and attention.

items.definition: mức độ, phạm vi; quy mô
items.pattern: 'to some/a certain/a large extent' là ở mức độ nào đó; 'the extent of the damage' là mức độ thiệt hại; dễ nhầm với động từ 'extend'.

examples.en: Nobody realized the full extent of the damage until morning.
To some extent, both sides were to blame for the mistake.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: The report revealed the full ___ of the damage caused by the flooding.
Scientists disagree about the ___ to which diet influences the condition.

items.definition: hộ gia đình, những người sống chung một nhà; (liên quan đến) việc nhà
items.pattern: 'a household of five', 'household chores/income'; 'a household name' là cái tên quen thuộc với mọi nhà.

examples.en: Every household on the street received a letter from the council.
In many families, household tasks are shared between members.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: Each ___ received a questionnaire asking about monthly energy consumption.
The new regulations apply to every ___ that uses a domestic gas boiler.

items.definition: hạ xuống, giảm (giá/âm lượng/mức); cúi, hạ thấp (thân thể)
items.pattern: Động từ: 'lower the price/voice/your eyes'; trái nghĩa 'raise'; đừng nhầm với 'lower' là dạng so sánh của tính từ 'low'.

examples.en: Please lower your voice; the baby is sleeping.
The shop lowered its prices to attract more customers.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: The central bank may ___ interest rates if inflation continues to fall.
The nurse asked him to ___ his arm so she could check the injury.

items.definition: sự giao hàng, việc phân phát; cách trình bày (bài nói); ca sinh nở
items.pattern: 'home delivery', 'delivery date/service', 'on delivery'; cũng chỉ phong cách diễn thuyết; động từ là 'deliver'.

examples.en: The delivery arrived two days later than promised.
We offer free delivery on orders over fifty pounds.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: The online shop promised free next-day ___ of the replacement laptop.
Her calm, confident ___ made an otherwise complicated presentation easy to follow.

items.definition: bên ngoài, ở ngoài; từ bên ngoài (không thuộc tổ chức)
items.pattern: 'external factors/walls'; 'for external use only' (thuốc bôi ngoài); trái nghĩa 'internal'; 'external examiner' là giám khảo mời từ ngoài.

examples.en: The external walls of the house need a fresh coat of paint.
Several external factors affected the company's profits.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: The organisation hired an ___ auditor to examine its financial records independently.
The protective coating prevents moisture from damaging the ___ walls.

items.definition: nhà ở, chỗ ở (nói chung); việc cung cấp nhà ở
items.pattern: Không đếm được; 'affordable/public housing', 'the housing market/crisis'; khác 'house' chỉ một ngôi nhà cụ thể.

examples.en: The city needs more affordable housing for young families.
Rising prices have made the housing market difficult for buyers.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: The city invested in affordable ___ for families with low incomes.
Lack of suitable ___ forced many young adults to remain with their parents.

items.definition: phổi
items.pattern: Thường số nhiều 'lungs'; 'lung cancer/disease'; 'at the top of your lungs' là hét hết cỡ; là cơ quan hô hấp.

examples.en: The doctor listened carefully to his left lung.
Smoking can seriously damage your lungs over time.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: Doctors examined his left ___ after he complained of breathing difficulties.
Smoking can cause serious damage to the ___ and reduce their ability to absorb oxygen.

items.definition: nhu cầu (kinh tế); yêu cầu, đòi hỏi; (demands) áp lực
items.pattern: 'demand for' là nhu cầu đối với; 'in demand' là được ưa chuộng; 'supply and demand'; 'meet the demands of'.

examples.en: There is a growing demand for electric cars in the city.
The job places heavy demands on your time and energy.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: There is growing ___ for apartments close to public transport.
The workers' main ___ was a fairer system for calculating overtime pay.

items.definition: phi thường, đặc biệt, khác thường
items.pattern: Nhấn mạnh sự vượt trội hoặc bất ngờ: 'an extraordinary achievement/talent'; trái nghĩa 'ordinary'; trạng từ 'extraordinarily'.

examples.en: She showed extraordinary courage during the rescue.
It was an extraordinary coincidence that they met again.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: Her ability to remember thousands of details was quite ___.
The scientists reported an ___ discovery that challenged existing explanations.

items.definition: duy trì, giữ gìn; bảo trì, bảo dưỡng; khẳng định, một mực cho rằng
items.pattern: 'maintain a level/relationship' (duy trì), 'maintain a car/road' (bảo trì), 'maintain that...' (khẳng định); danh từ 'maintenance'.

examples.en: It is hard to maintain a healthy diet while travelling.
He maintained that he had done nothing wrong.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: Engineers regularly inspect the bridge to ___ its safety.
The lawyer continued to ___ that her client had not committed the offence.

items.definition: chứng minh, thể hiện; trình diễn, làm mẫu; biểu tình
items.pattern: 'demonstrate that/how', 'demonstrate a skill'; 'demonstrate against' là biểu tình phản đối; danh từ 'demonstration'.

examples.en: The results clearly demonstrate that the new method works.
A teacher demonstrated how to use the machine safely.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: The teacher used a simple experiment to ___ how heat expands metal.
Thousands of people gathered peacefully to ___ against the proposed law.

items.definition: hài hước, hóm hỉnh, gây cười
items.pattern: Tả người/bài viết/nhận xét; đồng nghĩa 'funny, witty'; lưu ý chính tả 'humorous' (bỏ chữ u thứ hai của humour); trạng từ 'humorously'.

examples.en: He gave a humorous speech that made the whole room laugh.
Her emails are always full of humorous remarks.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: Her ___ account of the journey made everyone at dinner laugh.
The columnist wrote a ___ article about the difficulties of working from home.

items.definition: đa số, phần lớn; đa số phiếu (chính trị)
items.pattern: 'the majority of' + danh từ số nhiều; trái nghĩa 'minority'; 'win by a large majority'; động từ chia theo nghĩa thực tế.

examples.en: The majority of students passed the final exam.
The party won the election with a large majority.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2

The ___ of students completed the assignment well before the deadline.

items.definition: phủ nhận, chối; từ chối cho (quyền hay thứ gì)
items.pattern: 'deny doing sth / that...' (phủ nhận), 'deny sb sth' (không cho ai cái gì); trái nghĩa 'admit'; danh từ 'denial'.

examples.en: He continued to deny any involvement in the crime.
They were denied access to the building without a pass.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2

The authorities decided to ___ entry to visitors without the required permits.

items.definition: cơ sở, tiện nghi, trang thiết bị (thường số nhiều); năng khiếu (làm gì đó dễ dàng)
items.pattern: 'sports/medical facilities', 'a research facility'; 'a facility for languages' là năng khiếu ngôn ngữ.

examples.en: The hotel has a modern facility for conferences and meetings.
The town lacks basic facilities such as a library and a clinic.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2

The research ___ contains specialised rooms for testing infectious materials.

items.definition: sự hài hước, tính hài hước; khiếu hài hước; (nghĩa cổ) tâm trạng
items.pattern: Viết 'humour' (Anh), 'humor' (Mỹ); 'a sense of humour' là khiếu hài hước; 'good/bad humour' là tâm trạng tốt/xấu.

examples.en: Her sense of humour helped the team through difficult days.
There was a touch of humour in his serious speech.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: His ability to find ___ in difficult situations helped the team remain positive.
The comedian used gentle ___ to discuss otherwise sensitive social issues.

items.definition: buồn chán, chán nản, trầm cảm; suy thoái (kinh tế/vùng)
items.pattern: Tả cảm xúc 'feel depressed about'; nghĩa kinh tế 'a depressed area/economy'; mạnh hơn 'sad'; phân biệt với 'depressing' (gây chán nản).

examples.en: He felt depressed after losing his job last winter.
The factory closures left the whole region economically depressed.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: After months of isolation, he felt increasingly ___ and sought professional support.
The region's ___ economy had left many factories empty and unemployment high.

items.definition: sự thất bại; người/vật thất bại; sự hỏng hóc; việc không làm (failure to do)
items.pattern: Trái nghĩa 'success'; 'end in failure'; 'a power/engine failure' là sự cố; 'failure to do sth' là việc không làm gì.

examples.en: The project ended in complete failure despite everyone's effort.
His failure to reply on time cost the company the deal.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: The mission ended in ___ when the spacecraft lost contact with Earth.
An unexpected engine ___ forced the pilot to return to the airport.

items.definition: gây buồn chán, làm nản lòng, ảm đạm
items.pattern: Tả thứ khiến ta buồn (tin tức, thời tiết, nơi chốn); phân biệt với 'depressed' (cảm thấy buồn); 'a depressing film/sight'.

examples.en: The news about the floods was deeply depressing.
Living in that grey, depressing flat affected her mood.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: The report's account of rising homelessness was deeply ___.
It was ___ to see the once-busy shopping centre full of empty stores.

items.definition: niềm tin, lòng tin; đức tin, tín ngưỡng
items.pattern: 'have faith in sb/sth' là tin tưởng; 'lose faith'; 'in good faith' là với thiện ý; tôn giáo: 'the Christian faith'.

examples.en: She never lost faith in her son's ability to change.
People of every faith were welcome at the ceremony.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: Even after several failed attempts, she maintained her ___ in the project's success.
His religious ___ influenced how he approached charity and community service.

items.definition: việc săn bắn; việc săn lùng, tìm kiếm
items.pattern: 'go hunting', 'fox hunting'; ghép thành 'house-hunting, job-hunting'; bắt nguồn từ động từ 'hunt'.

examples.en: Hunting was once the main way these tribes found food.
The village has strict rules about hunting in the forest.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: Illegal ___ has reduced the number of elephants in the reserve.
The region prohibited ___ of rare birds during their breeding season.

items.definition: khối, đống (lớn); số đông, quần chúng (the masses); khối lượng (vật lý); Thánh lễ (tôn giáo)
items.pattern: 'a mass of' là một đống/khối; 'the masses' là quần chúng; tính từ 'mass production/media'; trong vật lý là khối lượng.

examples.en: A thick mass of cloud covered the mountain by noon.
The factory switched to mass production to meet demand.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: Scientists measured the object's ___ in kilograms rather than its volume.
A huge ___ of ice broke away from the glacier and fell into the sea.

items.definition: độ sâu, chiều sâu; sự sâu sắc (kiến thức, cảm xúc)
items.pattern: 'in depth' là kỹ lưỡng, sâu; 'depth of knowledge'; 'out of your depth' là quá sức; bắt nguồn từ tính từ 'deep'.

examples.en: The divers measured the depth of the lake carefully.
She discussed the topic in great depth during the lecture.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: The diver measured the ___ of the lake before beginning the survey.
Her argument showed considerable ___ because she had studied the subject for years.

items.definition: lỗi, khuyết điểm; trách nhiệm (do ai gây ra); đứt gãy địa chất
items.pattern: 'it's my fault' là lỗi của tôi; 'find fault with' là bắt lỗi; 'a fault in the system' là lỗi kỹ thuật; khác 'mistake' (fault nhấn trách nhiệm/khuyết điểm).

examples.en: The accident was entirely his fault.
The engineers found a fault in the electrical system.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: The engineer traced the power failure to a ___ in the control circuit.
It was not her ___ that the train arrived late after the storm.

items.definition: to lớn, khổng lồ, đồ sộ; rất lớn (về mức độ)
items.pattern: Thân mật, nhấn mạnh: 'a massive building/increase/success'; đồng nghĩa 'huge, enormous'; trạng từ 'massively'.

examples.en: They built a massive bridge across the river.
The concert was a massive success with record ticket sales.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: The earthquake caused ___ damage to roads, bridges and hospitals.
A ___ crowd gathered in the square to hear the singer perform.

items.definition: bậc thầy, chuyên gia; chủ (của vật nuôi/người hầu); (cũ) thầy giáo; (master's) thạc sĩ
items.pattern: 'a master of' là bậc thầy về; 'a master's degree' là bằng thạc sĩ; động từ 'master' là thành thạo; một số nghĩa đã mang sắc thái cổ.

examples.en: He is a master of storytelling who holds every listener's attention.
The dog waited patiently for its master to return.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: The young musician studied under a violin ___ renowned for his technique.
The dog recognised its ___'s voice even in a crowded room.

items.definition: xứng đáng (được hưởng hoặc bị phạt)
items.pattern: 'deserve sth / to do sth'; không dùng ở thì tiếp diễn; 'well-deserved' là hoàn toàn xứng đáng; dùng được cho cả nghĩa tích cực lẫn tiêu cực.

examples.en: Honest workers deserve fair pay for what they do.
They deserve to win after all their effort this season.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: Volunteers who worked throughout the emergency ___ public recognition.
The judge believed the offender did not ___ such a severe punishment.

items.definition: lông vũ, lông chim
items.pattern: Danh từ đếm được; hay gắn với chim hoặc gối, chăn ('down feather' là lông tơ); thành ngữ 'as light as a feather' nghĩa là rất nhẹ.

examples.en: A single feather drifted down from the nest above us.
She noticed bright blue feathers scattered across the garden path.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: The child found a blue ___ that had fallen from the bird's wing.
Scientists examined a fossilised ___ preserved in ancient rock.

items.definition: minh họa, làm rõ bằng ví dụ; vẽ tranh minh họa (cho sách)
items.pattern: Thường dùng 'illustrate something with an example/a story'; trong văn cảnh học thuật nghĩa là giải thích cho dễ hiểu, không chỉ là vẽ tranh.

examples.en: Let me illustrate the idea with a simple everyday example.
The teacher used a short video to illustrate how volcanoes form.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: The lecturer used a chart to ___ the difference between the two trends.
A local artist was commissioned to ___ the children's storybook.

items.definition: khớp nhau, cùng bộ, tương xứng
items.pattern: Đứng trước danh từ: 'a matching pair', 'matching colours'; ngụ ý hai thứ hợp nhau hoặc giống hệt để tạo thành một bộ.

examples.en: They arrived wearing matching jackets without planning it.
The curtains and the cushions came in matching shades of green.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: The twins wore ___ jackets so they looked almost identical.
She bought a blue handbag and a ___ pair of shoes for the ceremony.

items.definition: khao khát, niềm mong muốn mãnh liệt
items.pattern: Trang trọng hơn 'wish'; hay dùng 'a desire to do sth' hoặc 'a desire for sth'; 'a burning desire' là khao khát cháy bỏng.

examples.en: Her desire to travel the world only grew stronger with age.
There was a clear desire for change among the younger staff.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: His lifelong ___ to become a doctor motivated him to study at night.
The company showed little ___ to change its practices despite public complaints.

items.definition: lệ phí, phí (trả cho dịch vụ hoặc chuyên môn)
items.pattern: Thường đi với dịch vụ chuyên nghiệp: 'tuition fee', 'legal fees', 'entrance fee'; khác 'fare' (tiền vé đi lại) và 'fine' (tiền phạt).

examples.en: The gallery charges a small fee for guided tours.
Lawyers in that city tend to demand very high fees.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: The university charges an application ___ that must be paid before submission.
The lawyer explained her hourly ___ before agreeing to take the case.

items.definition: hình minh họa (trong sách); sự minh họa, ví dụ làm rõ
items.pattern: Nghĩa cụ thể là tranh hoặc ảnh trong sách; nghĩa trừu tượng 'an illustration of sth' là một ví dụ điển hình cho điều gì đó.

examples.en: The children's book is full of colourful illustrations.
His reaction was a perfect illustration of how stress affects people.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: The biology textbook includes a detailed ___ of the human heart.
The teacher offered a simple ___ to explain an otherwise abstract principle.

items.definition: tuyệt vọng, cùng quẫn; liều lĩnh vì quá cần thứ gì
items.pattern: 'be desperate for sth' hoặc 'desperate to do sth' nghĩa là rất cần hoặc rất muốn; sắc thái mạnh, khẩn thiết.

examples.en: They were desperate for any news about the missing climbers.
After hours without water, the hikers grew desperate.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: With no food or water left, the trapped hikers became increasingly ___.
She was ___ to speak to a doctor after the pain became unbearable.

items.definition: trí tưởng tượng; sức sáng tạo
items.pattern: Thường không đếm được; hay dùng 'use your imagination', 'a vivid imagination'; 'it's all in your imagination' nghĩa là chỉ là tưởng tượng thôi.

examples.en: Writing stories really stretches a child's imagination.
With a little imagination, the empty room could become a studio.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: The novel's imaginary worlds reveal the author's extraordinary ___.
Children often use their ___ to invent stories and games from ordinary objects.

items.definition: tối đa, lớn nhất
items.pattern: Đứng trước danh từ: 'maximum speed', 'maximum capacity'; trái nghĩa 'minimum'; viết tắt thông dụng là 'max'.

examples.en: The lift has a maximum load of eight people.
Drivers must not exceed the maximum speed on this road.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: The sign states that the ___ speed permitted on this road is fifty kilometres per hour.
The theatre has a ___ seating capacity of three hundred.

items.definition: phản hồi, ý kiến đánh giá
items.pattern: Không đếm được: 'give/get/receive feedback', 'positive/negative feedback', 'constructive feedback'; không nói 'a feedback'.

examples.en: The manager gave me helpful feedback on my presentation.
We collect customer feedback through short online surveys.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: The teacher provided detailed ___ on the strengths and weaknesses of each essay.
Customer ___ helped the company identify problems with its new app.

items.definition: thiếu kiên nhẫn, sốt ruột, nóng lòng
items.pattern: 'impatient with sb' là bực mình với ai; 'impatient to do sth' là nóng lòng làm gì; trái nghĩa 'patient'.

examples.en: He gets impatient when the train is even a few minutes late.
The children were impatient to open their presents.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: The children became ___ after waiting an hour for the delayed train.
He was too ___ to read the full instructions before assembling the desk.

items.definition: phương tiện, cách thức (để đạt mục đích)
items.pattern: Dạng số ít và số nhiều giống nhau ('a means', 'many means'); hay dùng 'a means of transport', 'by means of', 'a means to an end'.

examples.en: For many people, a bicycle is the cheapest means of getting to work.
They had no means of contacting anyone on the island.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: For remote villages, a boat is often the only ___ of crossing the river.
The researchers lacked the financial ___ to purchase the necessary equipment.

items.definition: chi tiết, tỉ mỉ, kỹ lưỡng
items.pattern: Đứng trước danh từ: 'a detailed report/plan/description'; nhấn mạnh có nhiều thông tin cụ thể; trái nghĩa 'vague, general'.

examples.en: The guide gave us a detailed map of the old town.
Investigators wrote a detailed account of the accident.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: The investigator produced a ___ report containing photographs, dates and witness statements.
Before renovating the building, the architect prepared ___ drawings of every room.

items.definition: ngụ ý, ám chỉ (không nói thẳng); hàm chứa, kéo theo
items.pattern: Người nói 'imply' (ám chỉ), người nghe 'infer' (suy ra) là hai từ dễ nhầm; hay dùng 'imply that + mệnh đề'.

examples.en: Are you trying to imply that I made a mistake?
Her silence seemed to imply that she disagreed.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: Her silence seemed to ___ that she disagreed, although she never said so.
The figures ___ that demand may exceed supply during the winter.

items.definition: số đo, kích thước; phép đo, sự đo lường
items.pattern: Số nhiều 'measurements' là các số đo (dài, rộng, cao...); 'take a measurement' nghĩa là tiến hành đo.

examples.en: Before buying the sofa, take a careful measurement of the doorway.
The tailor wrote down all my measurements.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: The carpenter took an exact ___ of the doorway before ordering the new frame.
The laboratory repeated each ___ three times to check for errors.

items.definition: phát hiện, nhận ra (điều khó thấy)
items.pattern: Hay dùng với giác quan hoặc thiết bị: 'detect a smell', 'sensors detect movement'; danh từ 'detection', thiết bị là 'detector'.

examples.en: The alarm can detect even a small amount of smoke.
Doctors detected the illness at an early stage.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: The sensor can ___ traces of smoke long before a fire becomes visible.
Doctors use the screening test to ___ certain diseases before symptoms appear.

items.definition: cùng cảnh ngộ, cùng nhóm (đồng nghiệp, bạn học...)
items.pattern: Chỉ đứng trước danh từ: 'fellow students', 'fellow passengers', 'fellow workers'; mang nghĩa chung hoàn cảnh, cùng nhóm.

examples.en: She shared her notes with a fellow student before the exam.
He thanked his fellow passengers for their patience during the delay.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: She asked her ___ researchers to review the data before publication.
Several ___ passengers helped the elderly woman carry her luggage.

items.definition: áp đặt, bắt tuân theo (luật, thuế, hình phạt)
items.pattern: 'impose sth on sb/sth' là áp đặt lên; 'impose on sb' còn nghĩa làm phiền hoặc lợi dụng lòng tốt của ai.

examples.en: The government may impose new taxes on imported cars.
I didn't want to impose my opinion on the whole group.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: The court may ___ a heavy fine on companies that break environmental laws.
The government announced plans to ___ new restrictions on industrial waste.

items.definition: đào, bới (đất)
items.pattern: Chia bất quy tắc: dig - dug - dug; 'dig a hole', 'dig for sth' là đào tìm; 'dig up' là đào lên hoặc moi ra (cả nghĩa thông tin).

examples.en: They decided to dig a pond in the back garden.
The dog loves to dig in the soft soil near the fence.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: Archaeologists began to ___ carefully around the buried pottery.
The dog tried to ___ a hole beneath the garden fence.

items.definition: gây ấn tượng, làm ai nể phục
items.pattern: 'impress sb with sth'; 'impress sth on sb' là khắc sâu điều gì vào tâm trí ai; danh từ là 'impression'.

examples.en: She hoped her project would impress the interview panel.
The young pianist impressed everyone in the hall.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: Her ability to answer difficult questions was sure to ___ the interview panel.
The chef hoped to ___ the guests with an unusual three-course dinner.

items.definition: tan chảy; làm cho tan ra
items.pattern: Chia quy tắc: melted; trái nghĩa 'freeze'; nghĩa bóng 'melt away' là tan biến dần, 'melt into tears' trong văn chương.

examples.en: The ice will melt quickly in this heat.
She let the chocolate melt slowly on her tongue.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: The ice will ___ quickly if it is left in direct sunlight.
The baker gently ___ the chocolate over a pan of warm water.

items.definition: kỷ luật, sự rèn giũa; môn học, ngành chuyên môn
items.pattern: Hai nghĩa: 'self-discipline' (tính kỷ luật) và 'an academic discipline' (một ngành học); nghĩa đầu không đếm được.

examples.en: Learning an instrument takes patience and discipline.
History and physics are very different disciplines.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: A successful marathon runner needs enough ___ to train even on difficult days.
Linguistics is an academic ___ that examines how human language works.

items.definition: ấn tượng, nể phục (bị điều gì đó gây ấn tượng)
items.pattern: 'be impressed by/with sb/sth'; chỉ cảm xúc của người, khác 'impressive' (bản thân sự vật gây ấn tượng).

examples.en: The judges were clearly impressed by her confident answers.
I'm impressed with how quickly you finished the work.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: The judges were ___ by the student's original solution to the problem.
We were particularly ___ with how calmly the nurse handled the emergency.

items.definition: thuộc quân đội, quân sự
items.pattern: Đứng trước danh từ: 'military service', 'military base'; 'the military' dùng như danh từ là lực lượng quân đội nói chung.

examples.en: The country increased its military spending last year.
He spent ten years in military service abroad.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: The government deployed ___ personnel to assist after the earthquake.
The museum displays ___ uniforms worn by soldiers during the war.

items.definition: tài chính; nguồn vốn, tiền bạc

examples.en: She studied finance before starting her own company.
The project was delayed because of problems with finance.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: The director studied ___ to understand how investment and company budgets work.
The project was cancelled when the organisation could no longer secure ___.

items.definition: insơ, inch (đơn vị đo dài bằng 2,54 cm)
items.pattern: Đơn vị đo chiều dài của Anh và Mỹ; thành ngữ 'inch by inch' là từng chút một; 'every inch' là hoàn toàn, trọn vẹn.

examples.en: The snow was almost an inch deep by morning.
Move the picture a few inches to the left.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: The carpenter measured the shelf and found it was one ___ too wide.
On this ruler, one ___ is divided into sixteen smaller marks.

items.definition: khoáng chất, khoáng sản

examples.en: Spinach is rich in iron and other minerals.
The region is mined for a valuable mineral used in batteries.

items.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B2
shortContexts: Calcium is an essential ___ that helps keep bones strong.
The geologist identified a rare ___ in a rock collected from the mountain.

items.definition: không trung thực, gian dối
